elementNameRule: every name in elementNameMap changes in .uxml name=, in .uss #id selectors and in the C# string passed to Q<>/Q(...)/BottomNavBinder.Bind. The other ~47 uxml names are not read by C# and may be renamed with the same token rules or left alone

persistedKeys.note: copy contents; both live under Application.persistentDataPath
cache only; safe to drop instead of migrate
already deleted by existing code; keep that DeleteKey

otherStrings.binaryHeader: StagePack.Magic 0x434C5041 ('APLC' = Arrow Puzzle Level Chunk) is a visible fingerprint of the old game. OPTIONAL: change to 0x434C444C ('LDLC'), bump Version to 3, re-bake, update the pack tests. Renaming identifiers alone does NOT change baked bytes.
otherStrings.logTags: [Ads]/[Campaign]/[Shapes] log prefixes are cosmetic; rename them in the same text pass if wanted

identifierRules.appliesTo: identifiers in .cs only (not string literals, not comments); run AFTER the type renames; skip the 5 serialized fields in fieldsRenamedWithFormerlySerializedAs_optionalPhaseB unless Phase B is chosen
identifierRules.distinctIdentifiersAffected: about 62 (arrows, arrow, wantArrows, RowArrows, spawnedArrows, arrowData, arrowCount, RemainingArrows, OnArrowCountChanged, TotalArrows, OnArrowLeft, PlayArrowClickBlocked, PlayArrowClickSuccess, FindHintableArrow, TryGetArrowBounds, FitCameraToSpawnedArrows and test method names)
identifierRules.collisionCheck: before applying, grep each candidate new identifier (DragonHead, DragonPearl, dragonHead, dragonCount...) for collisions with existing names

doNotRename: Assets/GoogleMobileAds, Assets/Plugins, Assets/ExternalDependencyManager, Assets/MultiTech Studio (reference template), Assets/Plugins/Demigiant (DOTween) and Resources/DOTweenSettings.asset, Assets/TextMesh Pro, Packages/*, Library/*
Third-party/Unity types and members: GoogleMobileAds.*, PrimeTween, UnityEngine.UIElements built-ins, USS classes beginning unity-
Unity message methods (Awake, OnEnable, OnDisable, Update, LateUpdate, OnValidate, OnDestroy, OnApplicationFocus...)

HostBridge.BridgeClass string 'in.dicodeinfotech.arrowqubepuzzle.UnityAdBridge' and the package id / applicationIdentifier / companyName: the developer decides these (Story 007 questions), not part of this pass

Serialized field NAMES on every MonoBehaviour/ScriptableObject used in the scene, prefabs and assets (see serializedFieldsPerScript_leaveAlone): renaming loses the value unless [FormerlySerializedAs] is added

JsonUtility types: SaveData/ProgressData fields (version, currentLevelIndex, highestLevelCompleted) and PromoRemoteConfig fields (they mirror backend JSON keys). Class names may change, field names may not
Difficulty/StageTier enum member ORDER, StagePack.Dirs ORDER and the chunk header layout: they are the baked binary format. Member names may change, order and values may not
Unity .meta GUIDs: always move the .meta with the file, never delete or recreate
AudioMixer exposed parameter names and AudioMixerGroup names (serialized in the mixer, referenced by sfxMixerGroup)
